action_items: (Optional) Move the architects router into /app/backend/routers/architects.py — server.py is now ~6,200 lines.

(Optional) Add Razorpay env keys (RAZORPAY_KEY_ID, RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET) to backend/.env to enable INR payments end-to-end. Currently the route returns 500 'Razorpay not configured', which is gracefully accepted by the test.
critical_code_review_comments: Background analyze uses asyncio.create_task — fine for a single-pod deployment but won't survive pod restarts. For production scale, persist a 'pending_analysis' queue + add a worker process.

OpenCV keyframe extraction still synchronous inside async upload handler — on 500MB videos this blocks the event loop. Wrap _extract_keyframes call with await asyncio.to_thread() before launching publicly.
Architects share token uses uuid4().hex (128 bits, hex-encoded). Collision-resistant + URL-safe. Good.
Public share endpoints correctly redact user_id but inspection_id is exposed in the response body (safe — it's an opaque slug, not enumerable).
PDF generation is synchronous (reportlab) inside the request handler — on large reports this could spike latency. For >100 findings consider a background generator + caching.
